title: Say He's Not Home: A Two-Tap Fix for a Family Kiosk | vitalii.no
description:
Presence on the family TV kiosk was driven only by the hallway camera, so when one of four boys was out at a friend's house, the system still counted him as present and factored him into the shared lock and turn logic — until the camera eventually lost track of him, which could take a while and left the other kids confused about whose turn applied.

I added a per-child "isn't home" button directly on the kiosk's TV page, with natural name phrasing and a two-tap confirm so a stray touch can't mark the wrong child away. Tapping it calls a new mark-away endpoint that flips that child inactive and clears his presence lock immediately. The hallway camera's existing endpoint still auto-reactivates him the instant it recognizes his face again, so there's no manual "I'm back" step.

Any of the four boys can now mark himself away in two taps the moment he leaves, instead of the whole family waiting on the camera's own timing for presence to catch up.
